def calculate_cost(N):

    matches = list(itertools.combinations(range(1, N + 1), 2))
    
    # 2. Schedule sequentially (Day 1 through Day M)

        p1, p2 = match
        
        # Update tracking for player p1
        first_match_day[p1] = min(first_match_day[p1], day)
        last_match_day[p1] = max(last_match_day[p1], day)
